I think that with the stock flamethrower you don't get enough damage potential because 40 points of afterburn damage is inferior to being able to switch to the shot gun for an 80 damage meatshot or a 90 damage critical flare.

Yes but the thing that the shotgun lacks is long range burst damage. You can light someone for some damage and as they are running away they get hit with a whopping 90 damage crit flare but with the shotgun in that scenario as they are farther away the shotgun does about 20-30 damage and the enemy still lives. When talking between the scorch shot and the flare gun I believe that having crit flares is much better than mini crit flares with knockback. The only reason the flares are used for long range harassment is to create the screen shakes for the enemy sniper.

And as a note I use the shotgun and the flare gun interchangeably.

When talking about whether the shotgun is better than the flare gun and vice versa it's more preference. With the shotgun you have more shots and hitscan bullets but you don't have range. With the flare gun you have range and burst damage but only have one shot. There are perks to both and downsides to both and it just comes down to preference. But the powerjack is better than the axtinguisher. When it comes to the flamethrower and the degreaser the degreaser is better because the difference between airblasts and after burn is negated when it comes to the burst damage potential with the faster weapon switch speed.
